provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled isotropic single-exponential rotational decorrelation with fixed fundamental anisotropy r0 and steady Perrin relation r=r0/(1+tau/theta). The measured fluorescence lifetime tau differs across samples; the rotational correlation time theta may be tested for a common positive value. No orientational restriction, multiexponential lifetime or changing r0.
scope: Do not convert theta into viscosity or hydrodynamic size without a separately supplied model/calibration. Anisotropy differences alone need not identify rotation changes when lifetime varies.
